description:
Rear Garden:
T1:  Large Lime - (growing close to the boundary):  Approximately 17.00.  Reduce the crown by up to 2.00m all round by means of reducing over extended branches back in to the main crown structure, preserving a natural crown line with ample furnishing growth.  Thin crown density by 20%.  Remove major dead wood throughout the crown.
T2:  Mature Sycamore:  Approximately 18.00m.  Reduce ivy back down the main stem to approximately 2.20m.  Remove low, weak epicormic growth on the main stem.  Remove major dead wood.
Reason/s:  General maintenance and to control encroachment.

Front Garden:
T3:  Lime - (right hand tree):  Approximately 17.00m.  Raise crown over the round by approximately 1.20m by means of removing the lowest epicormic growth on the main low branches.  Reduce lateral and sub lateral branches growing in the rear of the tree towards the house and roof by up to approximately 1.25m (not beyond the most recent points of reduction) to control encroachment.  Remove major dead wood.
T4:  Lime - (left hand tree):  Approximately 17.00m.  Remove low epicormic growth.  Reduce lateral and sub lateral branches growing to the rear of the tree towards and over the house and roof by approximately 1.25m (not beyond the most recent points of reduction) to control encroachment.  Remove major dead wood.
Reason/s:  General maintenance and to control encroachment.
